title: Cycle slot scaffold and skill delegation protocol
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Mid-cycle scope creep and emergency reassignments are causing velocity volatility and context switching across product and engineering teams. We lack a lightweight, repeatable mechanism to pre-authorize small scope changes and temporarily reassign specialist time without derailing planned deliverables.

Goal: Define and pilot a Cycle Slot Scaffold — a short, formalized micro-slot allocation and skill delegation process that: 1) reserves a small percentage of each initiative's engineering capacity for emergent critical work, 2) documents a fast approval path for scope swaps, and 3) provides a clear delegation pattern for rotating specialists so owners don't get pulled offline.

What this ticket delivers: a protocol doc (how to request/use a slot; guardrails; triage rubric), a 4-week pilot with two initiatives and one cross-functional shadow roster, instrumentation for three metrics (mid-cycle scope churn, specialist context switches, and on-time story completion), and a decision log for rollout or iteration. The pilot will include template PRDs, an on-call-ish calendar for skill delegation, and a lightweight intake form embedded in our PM/ENG workflow (Confluence + short Linear template).
acceptance_criteria: Protocol doc with step-by-step flow and decision gate published in Confluence (link included)
Pilot launched with two initiatives and formal slots reserved in cycle planning for at least 6% of dev capacity per initiative
Instrumentation dashboard shows baseline and weekly updates for the three metrics (scope churn, context switches, on-time completion)
At the end of the 4-week pilot, qualitative feedback collected from initiative leads and at least 2 iteration improvements recorded
Clear rollback criteria defined (if scope churn increases >10% or specialist context switches increase >30%, pause and re-evaluate)
decisions: Prioritize micro-slots over increased overall buffer to avoid harming committed OKR deliverables
Use a light approval path: initiative PM + engineering lead sign-off for any slot usage under 3 developer-days; program-level sign-off required above that
Shadow roster will be voluntary (rotations of 1 week) and only pull specialists for pre-approved slot tasks to limit disruption
Do not change current headcount allocation during the pilot; measure efficacy under existing staffing

2026-03-03: Product council reviewed the pilot; approved pilot start contingent on observability dashboard availability. Dashboard ticket created (ENG-83921).

notes_for_followup: If pilot meets success criteria, prepare rollout guide and lightweight automation: 1) a Linear template for slot intake, 2) small console view for initiative-level reserved capacity, and 3) a training snippet for PM/EM leads on delegation and rescue behavior. Consider tying to quarterly OKR gating for repeatability.
